data.action: 倚在浴缸里，一手扶缸沿，一膝抬起，另一手留在身下
data.camera: medium shot, looking into steaming bathtub, focus on wet pink hair and blushing smile
data.description: 雾气弥漫的浴室中，成年菈菈穿湿透的吊带衫倚在浴缸里，一手扶住缸沿，一膝抬起，尾巴浮在膝旁。磨砂玻璃透入柔和夜光。
data.lighting: 浴室磨砂玻璃透进的柔白夜光与水波荡漾的粼粼波光倒影
data.location: 热气蒸腾的家庭浴室大理石浴缸内
data.promptProse: Adult Lala reclines against the tub, gripping its edge while fingering herself underwater as her heart-tipped tail floats beside her raised knee. Soft white night light filters through frosted glass and reflects across the rippling water.
data.title: 菈菈 · 浴缸水汽中的爱心尾巴私密抚弄
data.animaCaption: Her heart-tipped tail floats beside the raised knee as one hand grips the tub edge.
